disciplinary_grounds.description: Holding oneself out as a perfusionist without meeting the required educational and examination requirements is a misdemeanor.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any person who violates this section is guilty of a misdemeanor.

definition_quote.value: "perfusion" means those functions necessary for the support, treatment, measurement, or supplementation of the cardiovascular system, circulatory system with or without the oxygenation circuit, or any combination of those activities, and to ensure the safe management of physiologic functions by monitoring the necessary parameters of those systems pursuant to an order and under the supervision of a licensed physician and surgeon.
definition_quote.quote: "perfusion" means those functions necessary for the support, treatment, measurement, or supplementation of the cardiovascular system, circulatory system with or without the oxygenation circuit, or any combination of those activities, and to ensure the safe management of physiologic functions by monitoring the necessary parameters of those systems pursuant to an order and under the supervision of a licensed physician and surgeon.

value: administration of pharmacological and therapeutic agents through extracorporeal circuit or IV line
methods_authorized.quote: Perfusion services include, but are not limited to, all of the following: (1) The use of extracorporeal circulation, cardiopulmonary support techniques, and other ancillary therapeutic and diagnostic technologies. (2) Counterpulsation, ventricular assistance, autotransfusion, including blood conservation techniques, myocardial and organ preservation, extracorporeal life support, and isolated limb perfusion. (3) The use of techniques involving blood management, advanced life support, and other related functions.

drug_authority.value: May administer pharmacological and therapeutic agents, blood products, or anesthetic agents through the extracorporeal circuit or through an intravenous line as ordered by a physician and surgeon, but only during the performance of perfusion functions described in subdivision (b).
drug_authority.quote: The administration of pharmacological and therapeutic agents, blood products, or anesthetic agents through the extracorporeal circuit or through an intravenous line as ordered by a physician and surgeon.
